Bettina, I haven't set up the Monday digest yet. My scheduler call failed with a gateway authentication error (`cron.list requires credentials`), so no recurring job exists and nothing will post on Monday 19 Oct at 08:00 Chicago time until it's fixed. An operator needs to restore the gateway's scheduler credentials. Once that's done, I can create the job. It would post in #coastal-team at 08:00 America/Chicago each Monday, starting 19 Oct, covering #coastal-team and #coastal-random.

One thing to plan for: this channel and #coastal-random have the same members, so I can post a combined digest here. Money terms (rates, prices, contract values, invoices) can't go in it, because this channel is not limited to the finance recipients. The digest will cover operational items only, such as seat counts, renewal dates, tickets and meetings. For pricing questions, the account owner or June Osei-Lark should be the contact.
